newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp sees Centralia unit up late Fri.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp sees Centralia unit up late Fri.

text.p: The 670-megawatt unit at the Centralia power plant in southwest Washington state which tripped off late Wednesday night, should be back up around midnight local/0700 GMT Friday, a spokesman for PacifiCorp said Thursday.
The coal-fired unit was taken down for repairs to a boiler tube leak, said spokesman Dave Kvamme. The same unit was down between Saturday and Monday for the same problem.
Centralia's other 670-MW unit was operating at normal levels, said PacifiCorp, which operates and owns a 47.5 percent stake in Centralia.
